verdict.rationale: Trilegal runs a dedicated DPDP Act Repository microsite with a DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool, readiness guidance and sector infographics. Its AI practice page also claims 'deep expertise in compliance, IP, and data privacy.' This shows real data-protection counselling capability under India's DPDP Act, but the evidence shows no standalone privacy/cyber practice page, and other regimes are not covered. Missing for 10: a dedicated documented privacy/cybersecurity practice page, evidence of GDPR/CCPA or cross-border privacy advice, named privacy mandates or rankings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Stay updated with the latest insights on India's new data protection law and its implications
With deep expertise in compliance, IP, and data privacy, we guide clients through the dynamic legal landscape of AI
